monitoring.recommendation: Retain original strict capacity gate. Separate hosted functional/latency evidence from strict resource certification.
monitoring.originalStrictProtocol: 1-second fresh complete resource observations; sustained CPU window 10 seconds; at least 20% headroom
monitoring.freeNativeMetricProtocol: 60-second scrapes; entitlement and underlying series freshness unverified
monitoring.alternativeForOwnerReview: Approve a separately named 60-second hosted-observation protocol for a later functional/latency pilot, with DB disk/connections, all observed runtime instances, driver memory, timeouts and quota stops; explicitly exclude 10-second CPU and complete infrastructure memory certification.
monitoring.coordinatorResources: Seal and observe the additional persistent coordinator process and its host RAM/disk/CPU; it is not hidden in the existing app or driver budget.

traffic.recommendation: Measure a separately approved target-only pilot before full testing; seal every channel with 2x forecast plus 25% wire allowance, a 1 GB cap and at least 2 GB protected-source reserve.
traffic.stopDecision: If allowance, source consumption bound or complete forecast cannot be proved, stop; obtain an isolated test-organization quote or smaller explicitly approved scope. Do not upgrade the selected organization or spend its protected allowance.

uploads.recommendation: Preserve existing application contracts. Keep full Vercel payload compatibility NO-GO and separate it from normal 256 KiB fixture acceptance.
uploads.separateChangeForOwnerReview: Review direct/streamed per-file uploads with durable command/effect ownership, or a separately quoted persistent app host plus an explicitly approved aggregate-request limit. Both require dedicated application/design acceptance, not a silent test-only limit reduction.

coordinator.recommendation: One persistent operator-owned coordinator with private HTTPS, separate runtime/operator tokens, exclusive durable storage and independent encrypted evidence. Never use serverless temporary files as the authority.

criticalPathDisposition.monitoring: Recommend native-resolution operational release evidence; strict 1s/10s CPU certificate remains BLOCKED, no safety/security waiver
criticalPathDisposition.traffic: Retain measured 50 MB pilot / full forecast / 1 GB cap / protected reserve; no execution or spend approved
criticalPathDisposition.uploads: Pre-existing platform incompatibility may be deferred for database-only cutover only with owner acceptance and unchanged normal-flow proof; required large-file support means MUST FIX
criticalPathDisposition.securityScope: Owner selects current application/access behavior; new security implementation next phase; existing safeguards and unresolved-risk reporting preserved
